summary.name: LISA
summary.one_liner: LISA is USENIX's long-running Large Installation System Administration conference, listed here as a year-by-year archive of events from 1993 to 2021.
use_cases: Finding the dates and locations of past LISA conferences
Researching the history of system administration conferences
Checking which years LISA was held and where
Locating USENIX conference proceedings by year
summary.what_it_does: The page is a table listing LISA (Large Installation System Administration) conferences by year, from 1993 to 2021. Each row gives the edition number, the title, the dates, and the city and country for most entries. The earliest entries use the older name 'Systems Administration Conference' before the LISA name appears. The page shows no sessions, papers, or registration details beyond this listing.
notable: Covers 29 editions from 1993 to 2021 in one table
Shows the shift from the 'Systems Administration Conference' name to 'Large Installation System Administration Conference'
2020 is absent from the listing; the 2021 edition was held June 1-3, 2021
caveats: Page is a listing only; no details on content, cost, or registration
Location is blank for the 2021 entry
The page does not explain why 2020 is missing
